target: Kimi Code k3 via existing CLI
findings: Official moonshotai/Kimi-K3 repository publishes tokenizer configuration and XTML encoder. This is positive evidence of an official local tokenizer, not a demonstrated serving-template equivalence for Kimi Code k3.
Official Code model documentation distinguishes k3 from kimi-for-coding. Counts cannot be transferred between these IDs by inference.

Official estimate-token-count documentation targets api.moonshot.ai/v1/tokenizers/estimate-token-count. The consulted documentation does not establish a count contract for coding/v1/messages/count_tokens.
Official kimi-cli llm.py estimate_request_tokens uses ASCII/4 plus non-ASCII character heuristic; this is not native tokenization.
gap: No verified official binding between the published tokenizer/template, the existing CLI request envelope and the Kimi Code k3 serving path was found in the consulted sources. Unverified contract does not establish that no such service exists.
decision: Do not replace the current admission bound with a native count until this exact-route contract is verified. Preserve text, provider window and output reserves; fail closed under the operator condition.
scope: Read-only public official documentation/code review. No credentials read, authenticated request, generation, installation, model switch or runtime modification. This is a bounded documentary conclusion, not an exhaustive absence claim.
